name: Granola
tagline: Bot-free AI notepad that turns your own meeting notes and device audio into finished notes.
bestFor: People in back-to-back meetings who want notes without a bot joining the call
description: Granola captures your computer's audio instead of sending a bot, then combines what it heard with the notes you typed to write up the meeting. The Basic plan is free with 30 days of meeting history, and Business costs $14 per user per month.
pros: No bot joins the call; it captures device audio from Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, WebEx and Slack huddles
Free Basic plan has no stated cap on meetings and includes AI chat, shared folders and custom templates
Business adds HubSpot, Attio, Affinity, Notion and Zapier integrations plus an API and MCP server
SOC 2 Type II listed on every plan
cons: Free Basic plan only shows 30 days of meeting history
Salesforce integration, HIPAA workspaces and SSO are Enterprise only, and SSO needs 50+ users
No annual billing price is published
freePlanDetails: Basic: AI meeting notes, AI chat across meetings (auto model only), shared folders, custom templates, voice typing; meeting history limited to 30 days. Excludes pre-meeting briefs, follow-up emails, most integrations and API.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 30 days of meeting history; Slack integration only.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user per month. Unlimited notes and history, model selection, HubSpot/Attio/Affinity/Notion/Zapier, API and MCP, centralized billing. No annual price published.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Per user per month (Granola's llms.txt says $35+). Adds SSO (workspaces with 50+ users), HIPAA workspaces, SCIM, audit API, Salesforce, workspace analytics and admin controls.

integrations: Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Attio, Affinity, Zapier, Salesforce (Enterprise), API, MCP

name: Avoma
tagline: AI meeting assistant with transcription, notes, scheduling and add-on conversation and revenue intelligence.
bestFor: Sales and customer-success teams that want meeting notes saved to the CRM
description: Avoma records and transcribes meetings, writes AI notes, saves them to Salesforce or HubSpot records, and includes a meeting scheduler. Paid plans start at $29 per recorder seat per month, or $19 billed annually, and viewers are free.
pros: Unlimited AI notes and transcription on every paid plan
Viewers, listeners and collaborators do not need a paid seat
14-day trial of the Organization plan with all add-ons, no credit card
SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certified
cons: No free recording plan; after the trial the account can only view past recordings
Conversation Intelligence and Revenue Intelligence are extra add-ons at $29-$35 per seat per month
SSO and HIPAA are Enterprise only, which is annual-only with a 10-seat minimum
freePlanDetails: No free recording plan. Viewer accounts (watch recordings, read notes) are free.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: Per recorder seat; up to 25 paid seats. Unlimited AI notes and transcription, 1:1 scheduling, dialer integration.

plans.name: Organization
plans.notes: Per recorder seat; up to 100 paid seats. Adds custom AI templates, group/round-robin scheduling, API and webhooks.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Per recorder seat, annual billing only, minimum 10 paid seats. Adds SSO, HIPAA, data retention policies and a designated success manager. Optional add-ons on any plan, per seat: Conversation Intelligence or Revenue Intelligence $35 monthly / $29 annual each, Lead Router $25 monthly / $19 annual; optional onboarding $1,000 one-time.

integrations: Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex, GoToMeeting; Salesforce and HubSpot (two-way field updates need the Revenue Intelligence add-on); dialers; API and webhooks (Organization+)

name: Krisp
tagline: Bot-free AI meeting assistant with built-in noise cancellation, accent conversion and AI notes.
bestFor: Remote workers who want noise cancellation and meeting notes in one app
description: Krisp captures meeting audio on your device, removes background noise, and produces transcripts and AI notes for Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and other apps. There is a 7-day free trial, and Core costs $16 per user per month or $8 billed annually.
pros: Bot-free by default, working at the audio level with any conferencing app; an optional bot is available for Zoom
Unlimited AI notes, transcription and noise cancellation on Core
Annual billing halves the per-seat price
HubSpot, Pipedrive, Affinity, Slack, Notion and Zapier on Core
cons: No permanent free plan for Meeting AI, only a 7-day trial
Salesforce needs Advanced; SSO, SCIM and HIPAA are Enterprise only
Core limits accent conversion to 1 hour a day and storage to 10 GB

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Per user. Unlimited AI notes, transcription and noise cancellation; 1 hr/day accent conversion; 10 GB storage. A Black Friday code (KRISPBF2026) advertised 55% off annual plans on 2026-11-21.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per user. 4 hrs/day speaker-side accent conversion, unlimited listener-side; 60 GB storage; Salesforce and ConnectWise; BAA for teams with 100+ seats.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited storage, SSO/SCIM, HIPAA, SOC 2 report access, custom limits, dedicated account manager. Volume discounts above 50 seats.

integrations: Slack, Notion, Zapier, Microsoft Teams, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Affinity, MCP, API; Salesforce and ConnectWise (Advanced+)
compliance: HIPAA (Enterprise; BAA on Advanced for 100+ seats)

name: MeetGeek
tagline: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings in 100+ languages.
bestFor: Small teams that want CRM sync and a HIPAA BAA at a low per-seat price
description: MeetGeek records Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls through a bot, desktop app, Chrome extension or mobile app, then writes transcripts and AI summaries. The free Basic plan includes 3 transcription hours a month, and Pro costs $15.99 per user per month or $9.99 billed annually.
pros: Free Basic plan includes AI summaries, AI chat and 3 transcription hours a month
SOC 2 Type II on every plan, and a HIPAA BAA on annual Pro, Business or Enterprise plans
HubSpot, Salesforce and Pipedrive sync from Pro
Bot-free desktop app for macOS and Windows plus a Chrome extension and iOS/Android apps
cons: Pro is capped at 20 transcription hours a month, with extra hours at $0.50 each
Free recordings are capped at 2 hours each, with transcripts kept 3 months and audio 1 month
SSO and SCIM are Enterprise only
freePlanDetails: Basic: 3 hours of transcription per month, recordings up to 2 hours, transcripts kept 3 months, audio kept 1 month, AI summaries and AI chat, 100+ languages. No credit card.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 3 transcription hours/month; recording stops when they are used up. 100 API/MCP requests per day.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user. 20 transcription hours/month, extra hours $0.50 each; transcripts 1 year, audio 6 months; 2-hour recordings; CRM sync, Zapier/Make/n8n.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user. Unlimited transcription and transcript storage; audio and video kept 12 months; 3-hour recordings; 14-day trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom quote. SSO and SCIM, zero or custom data retention, on-premise storage options, 4-hour recordings, dedicated onboarding and support.

integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zapier, Make, n8n (Pro+); API and MCP; works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Slack and Discord

sources.label: MeetGeek help center: desktop app quickstart (macOS and Windows)
MeetGeek blog author page: Dan Huru (co-founded 2018)

name: Jamie
tagline: Bot-free AI note taker for online and in-person meetings, hosted in the EU.
bestFor: European teams that want bot-free notes with EU data hosting
description: Jamie runs on your device and records any online platform or in-person meeting without a bot, then writes summaries and action items; data is hosted in Germany. The free plan covers 10 meetings a month up to 30 minutes, and US customers pay $29 per month for Plus, or a reported $24 a month billed annually.
pros: No bot joins the call; works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex and in-person meetings
Data hosted and processed in the EU on German servers; GDPR and ISO 27001
Free plan includes 10 meetings a month and unlimited storage
Pro and above sync to HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, Dynamics 365 and Pipedrive
cons: Free meetings are capped at 30 minutes each
SOC 2 Type II is still listed as pending, and no HIPAA or BAA is advertised
Plus has no CRM integrations and allows 20 meetings a month
freePlanDetails: 10 meetings per month, 30-minute limit per meeting, Ask Jamie chat, 1 custom template, 50 custom vocabulary terms, unlimited storage; Google Docs, Notion and OneNote exports.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 20 meetings/month, 2 hours per meeting. US price; EUR price is 25 EUR monthly or 21 EUR billed annually. Annual USD figure is from a third-party breakdown.

plans.name: Pro (Individual)
plans.notes: Unlimited meetings, 5 hours per meeting, CRM integrations. US price; EUR price is 47 EUR monthly or 39 EUR billed annually. Annual USD figure is from a third-party breakdown.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per member. Unlimited meetings, 5 hours per meeting, 100 vocabulary terms. US price; EUR price is 39 EUR monthly or 33 EUR billed annually. Annual USD figure is from a third-party breakdown.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, billed annually, 10+ users. SAML SSO, DPAs, automatic exports to any endpoint, 250 vocabulary terms.

integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Attio, Dynamics 365, DealCloud (Pro+); Google Docs, Notion, OneNote (all plans)
